description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing BC-based chain offering a self-serve individual hot pot experience, with over 100 fresh and premium ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes to choose from. Each diner gets their own pot, making it a customizable, sit-down meal well-suited to a hungry touring cyclist. The Langley location opened in May 2025 and is part of a multi-province expansion also reaching Ontario and the US.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this as the Langley franchise of the Big Way Hot Pot chain (20202 66 Ave, Unit 130). The website's news page confirms a Langley grand opening on May 22, 2025, establishing the location as real and open. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are corroborated by the website's explicit 'Vegan Option Available' labels on the Tomato Broth and the emphasis on fresh vegetables throughout the menu. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom evidence appears on the website. The website's contact page address (2633 Viking Wy #208, Richmond) is a corporate headquarters address, not the restaurant address, and the site contains significant placeholder template content (Lorem ipsum, contact@sushi.com, 414-area-code dummy phone numbers) indicating an incompletely built-out web presence.
concerns: Website contains significant placeholder/template content throughout: Lorem ipsum body text, placeholder email 'contact@sushi.com', and dummy US phone numbers with a 414 area code — indicating the website is not fully built out and some displayed information may be inaccurate.

Website contact page address (2633 Viking Wy #208, Richmond, BC V6V 3B7) is a corporate headquarters address and does not match the OSM restaurant address (20202 66 Ave, Unit 130, Langley); OSM address unconfirmed via website.
